```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)

# Load the data
df <- read_csv("w2-avg-sleep-data.csv")
df <- df %>% select(-SID)

# Pastel palette
pastel_colors <- c("#AEC6CF", "#FFB347", "#B39EB5", "#77DD77", "#F49AC2")

# Loop through columns and plot
for (i in seq_along(df)) {
  col_name <- names(df)[i]
  color <- pastel_colors[(i - 1) %% length(pastel_colors) + 1]
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes_string(x = col_name)) +
    geom_density(fill = color, alpha = 0.7, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +  # Eyeliner, baby
    labs(title = paste("Density Plot of", col_name)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title.y = element_blank()
    )
  
  print(p)
}
```

```{r}
pastel_points <- c("#FBB4AE", "#B3CDE3", "#CCEBC5", "#DECBE4")
pastel_lines <- c("#FDBE85", "#A6CEE3", "#B2DF8A", "#CAB2D6")

# Generate all unique variable pairs
pairs <- combn(names(df), 2, simplify = FALSE)

# Loop through pairs and make pastel scatter plots
for (i in seq_along(pairs)) {
  pair <- pairs[[i]]
  x_var <- pair[1]
  y_var <- pair[2]
  
  # Correlation stuff
  test <- cor.test(df[[x_var]], df[[y_var]])
  r_val <- round(test$estimate, 2)
  p_val <- signif(test$p.value, 2)
  label <- paste0("r = ", r_val, ", p = ", p_val)
  
  # Pick pastel colors
  point_color <- pastel_points[(i - 1) %% length(pastel_points) + 1]
  line_color <- pastel_lines[(i - 1) %% length(pastel_lines) + 1]
  
  # Plot
  p <- ggplot(df, aes_string(x = x_var, y = y_var)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, color = point_color, size = 2.5) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = line_color, fill = line_color, alpha = 0.3) +
    annotate("text",
             x = Inf, y = -Inf,
             label = label,
             hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.5,
             size = 5, fontface = "italic") +
    labs(
      title = paste("Scatterplot of", y_var, "vs", x_var),
      x = x_var,
      y = y_var
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 15)
  
  print(p)
}
```

## Supervised Models

### XGBoost

```{r}
library(tidymodels)
library(vip)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(SHAPforxgboost)
set.seed(42)

# Load and prepare the data
df <- read.csv("w2-avg-sleep-data.csv") %>%
  select(-SID)

targets <- names(df)

# Function to build and tune model for a given target
run_model <- function(target, data) {
  rec <- recipe(as.formula(paste(target, "~ .")), data = data) %>%
    step_normalize(all_predictors())

  xgb_spec <- boost_tree(
    trees = tune(),
    tree_depth = tune(),
    learn_rate = tune(),
    loss_reduction = tune(),
    sample_size = tune(),
    mtry = tune()
  ) %>%
    set_engine("xgboost") %>%
    set_mode("regression")

  wf <- workflow() %>%
    add_model(xgb_spec) %>%
    add_recipe(rec)

  folds <- vfold_cv(data, v = 5)

  grid_vals <- grid_latin_hypercube(
    trees(),
    tree_depth(),
    learn_rate(),
    loss_reduction(),
    sample_size = sample_prop(),
    finalize(mtry(), data %>% select(-all_of(target))),
    size = 15
  )

  tuned <- tune_grid(
    wf,
    resamples = folds,
    grid = grid_vals,
    metrics = metric_set(rmse, rsq),
    control = control_grid(save_pred = TRUE)
  )

  best <- select_best(tuned, metric = "rmse")

  final_wf <- finalize_workflow(wf, best)
  final_fit <- fit(final_wf, data = data)

  # Training set R²
  preds_train <- predict(final_fit, data) %>%
    bind_cols(data %>% select(!!target))
  colnames(preds_train) <- c("prediction", "truth")
  rsq_train <- rsq(preds_train, truth = truth, estimate = prediction) %>%
    pull(.estimate)

  # Cross-validated R²
  best_config <- best %>% select(-.config)
  tuned_metrics <- collect_predictions(tuned) %>%
    inner_join(best_config, by = colnames(best_config)) %>%
    group_by(id) %>%
    rsq(truth = !!sym(target), estimate = .pred) %>%
    summarise(cv_rsq = mean(.estimate))

  rsq_cv <- mean(tuned_metrics$cv_rsq)

  # Feature importance (normalized gain)
  imp <- final_fit %>%
    pull_workflow_fit() %>%
    vip::vi(type = "gain") %>%
    mutate(
      NormalizedGain = Importance / sum(Importance),
      Target = target
    )

  list(
    target = target,
    rmse = show_best(tuned, metric = "rmse", n = 1),
    rsq_train = rsq_train,
    rsq_cv = rsq_cv,
    workflow = final_wf,
    fit = final_fit,
    importance = imp
  )
}

# Run model for each target
results <- map(targets, ~ run_model(.x, df))

# Combine and plot normalized importance
importance_df <- bind_rows(map(results, "importance"))

ggplot(importance_df, aes(x = reorder(Variable, NormalizedGain), y = NormalizedGain, fill = Target)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge()) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ Target, scales = "free") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Normalized XGBoost Feature Importance (Gain)",
    x = "Features", y = "Normalized Gain"
  )

# Print best RMSEs + R²s
walk(results, function(res) {
  cat("\nTarget:", res$target, "\n")
  print(res$rmse)
  cat("R² (Train):", round(res$rsq_train, 4), "\n")
  cat("R² (Cross-validated):", round(res$rsq_cv, 4), "\n")
})

```

### GLM

```{r}
library(tidymodels)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(broom)

set.seed(42)

# Load and prepare the data
df <- read.csv("w2-avg-sleep-data.csv") %>%
  select(-SID)

targets <- names(df)

# Function to run GLM model for a given target
run_glm_model <- function(target, data) {
  rec <- recipe(as.formula(paste(target, "~ .")), data = data) %>%
    step_normalize(all_predictors())

  glm_spec <- linear_reg() %>%
    set_engine("lm") %>%
    set_mode("regression")

  wf <- workflow() %>%
    add_model(glm_spec) %>%
    add_recipe(rec)

  folds <- vfold_cv(data, v = 5, repeats = 3)

  res <- fit_resamples(
    wf,
    resamples = folds,
    metrics = metric_set(rmse, rsq),
    control = control_resamples(save_pred = TRUE)
  )

  final_fit <- fit(wf, data = data)

  # Training set R²
  preds_train <- predict(final_fit, data) %>%
    bind_cols(data %>% select(!!target))
  colnames(preds_train) <- c("prediction", "truth")
  rsq_train <- rsq(preds_train, truth = truth, estimate = prediction) %>%
    pull(.estimate)

  # Cross-validated R²
  rsq_cv <- collect_metrics(res) %>%
    filter(.metric == "rsq") %>%
    summarise(cv_rsq = mean(mean)) %>%
    pull(cv_rsq)

  # Get coefficients
  coefs <- tidy(final_fit) %>%
    filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
    mutate(
      Target = target,
      term = gsub("`", "", term)  # Clean up variable names
    )

  list(
    target = target,
    rsq_train = rsq_train,
    rsq_cv = rsq_cv,
    workflow = wf,
    fit = final_fit,
    coefficients = coefs
  )
}

# Run model for each target
results_glm <- map(targets, ~ run_glm_model(.x, df))

# Print R²s
walk(results_glm, function(res) {
  cat("\nTarget:", res$target, "\n")
  cat("R² (Train):", round(res$rsq_train, 4), "\n")
  cat("R² (Cross-validated):", round(res$rsq_cv, 4), "\n")
})

# Combine coefficients for plotting
coef_df <- bind_rows(map(results_glm, "coefficients"))

# Plot standardized coefficients
ggplot(coef_df, aes(x = reorder(term, estimate), y = estimate, fill = Target)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge()) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ Target, scales = "free") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Standardized Regression Coefficients (GLM)",
    x = "Features", y = "Coefficient (Standardized)"
  )

```

## Unsupervised Models

### PCA+K-MEANS

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(cluster)

set.seed(42)

# Load and normalize the data
df <- read_csv("w2-avg-sleep-data.csv") %>%
  select(-SID)

norm_recipe <- recipe(~., data = df) %>%
  step_normalize(all_predictors()) %>%
  prep()

df_norm <- bake(norm_recipe, new_data = NULL)

# PCA
pca <- prcomp(df_norm, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)
pca_data <- as_tibble(pca$x)

# Elbow method for k = 1 to 10
elbow_df <- tibble(k = 1:10) %>%
  mutate(
    kmeans = map(k, ~ kmeans(pca_data[, 1:2], centers = .x, nstart = 10)),
    tot_withinss = map_dbl(kmeans, ~ .x$tot.withinss)
  )

# Plot elbow method
ggplot(elbow_df, aes(x = k, y = tot_withinss)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Elbow Method (PCA-reduced data)",
       x = "Number of Clusters (k)",
       y = "Total Within-Cluster SS")

# Choose k (manually from elbow plot, e.g. 3)
k_opt <- 3
final_kmeans <- kmeans(pca_data[, 1:2], centers = k_opt, nstart = 25)

# Add cluster labels to PCA data
pca_clustered <- pca_data %>%
  select(PC1, PC2) %>%
  mutate(cluster = as.factor(final_kmeans$cluster))

# Plot clusters in PCA space
ggplot(pca_clustered, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = paste("k-Means Clustering on PCA (k =", k_opt, ")"),
       x = "PC1", y = "PC2")

```

```{r}
df_clustered <- df_norm %>%
  mutate(cluster = as.factor(final_kmeans$cluster))

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

    x = "Cluster",
    y = "Standardized Value"
  )


```

### UMAP+HDBSCAN

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(umap)
library(dbscan)

set.seed(42)

# Load and normalize the data
df <- read_csv("w2-avg-sleep-data.csv") %>%
  select(-SID)

norm_recipe <- recipe(~., data = df) %>%
  step_normalize(all_predictors()) %>%
  prep()

df_norm <- bake(norm_recipe, new_data = NULL)

# Run UMAP (nonlinear dimensionality reduction)
umap_result <- umap(df_norm, n_neighbors = 15, min_dist = 0.1)
umap_df <- as_tibble(umap_result$layout) %>%
  rename(UMAP1 = V1, UMAP2 = V2)

# HDBSCAN clustering on UMAP space
hdb <- hdbscan(umap_df, minPts = 12)  # minPts = density sensitivity

# Add cluster labels
umap_df <- umap_df %>%
  mutate(cluster = as.factor(hdb$cluster))

# Plot UMAP clusters
ggplot(umap_df, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, color = cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(title = "UMAP + HDBSCAN Clustering",
       x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2")

```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Assuming `df_norm` is your normalized data
# And `umap_df$cluster` is your final clustering result

# Combine cluster labels with normalized data
df_clustered <- df_norm %>%
  mutate(cluster = umap_df$cluster)

# Get summary stats per cluster
cluster_summary <- df_clustered %>%
  pivot_longer(-cluster, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(cluster, variable) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(value),
    sd = sd(value),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(cluster, variable)

# Optional: pivot wider to see everything in a big table
cluster_summary_wide <- cluster_summary %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = variable,
    values_from = c(mean, sd),
    names_glue = "{variable}_{.value}"
  )

# View the summary
print(cluster_summary_wide, n = Inf)

```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Combine cluster labels with normalized data
df_clustered <- df_norm %>%
  mutate(cluster = umap_df$cluster)

# Get variable names (excluding the cluster label)
vars <- names(df_clustered)[names(df_clustered) != "cluster"]

# Loop through variables and generate violin plots
for (v in vars) {
  p <- ggplot(df_clustered, aes(x = cluster, y = .data[[v]], fill = cluster)) +
    geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.7, color = NA) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 1.2, alpha = 0.4, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Pastel1") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Violin Plot of", v, "by Cluster"),
      x = "Cluster",
      y = paste("Standardized", v)
    )

  print(p)
}
```
